digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud/DC adapter — user identity contract
propositions: Cloud identifies users by opaque accountId while Data Center identifies them by name, creating a contract that must be pinned at the protocol level.
PR #120's implementation using getattr-discovered _assignee_resolver creates an unreachable authoritative branch for DC, causing permanent non-authoritative assignee resolution and diff churn.
A UserIdentityModel protocol with AccountIdIdentity and NameIdentity implementations enables NameIdentity to perform real user-search lookups against DC, returning authoritative=True for convergence.
NameIdentity must receive the resolver as an explicit constructor parameter, not via optional attribute discovery, to eliminate the unreachable branch defect.

Contract tests must cover the 3-state resolution behavior (empty value, same identity converged, different identity resolved) for both implementations and assert DC returns authoritative=True for resolvable assignees.
